summary: Iteration 23 — Pricing engine (10-20% tiered margin), Auto Variance Alerts, and Employer-facing workspace all verified end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (pricing tiers ladder + floor 10, POST /pricing/quote math on mixed Principal/Junior/Mid team with 2% volume discount correctly applied, template detail returns monthly_client_price/monthly_talent_cost/total_client_price/total_talent_cost/total_margin/blended_margin_pct/pricing_tiers, team-suggestions candidates include sell_rate + margin_pct, POST /projects/lead recomputes server-side and returns quote (Senior $140/hr single seat → 15% → $161 sell → monthly $25760 → total $154560), convert stamps total_budget=total_client_price + carries total_talent_cost/total_margin/blended_margin_pct, contact_email → employer auto-link works (emp-series-b-fintechs sees the fresh project in /projects/mine, control fintech does NOT, talent gets 0, admin sees all), workspace 200 for linked employer / 403 for wrong employer, +25% variance triggers alert doc with severity=high in db.project_alerts, 0% variance returns alert=null, /alerts/mine scopes per role (linked employer sees 1 unread, talent empty, admin sees all), POST /alerts/{id}/read allowed for linked employer + 403 for talent). Frontend: Projects page template modal renders both data-testid=price-transparency ('Team cost $107.4k/mo · Job Atlas margin 15.8% · Total 6mo: $746k') AND data-testid=live-monthly-cost ('$124.3k You pay / mo'). Employer dashboard (/employer) for emp-series-b-fintechs shows data-testid=employer-projects with 2 project-card entries and data-testid=employer-alerts banner with the unread breach. Clicking a project-card navigates to /projects/{id}/workspace, project-workspace testid present, rollup-margin & admin-team-cost are correctly HIDDEN for employer, Back link reads 'Back'. Variance breach submission (+15/+15) fires toast 'Variance alert fired — sponsor notified' and after refresh data-testid=variance-alerts-banner renders with dismiss-alert-{id} button. Admin visiting the same workspace sees rollup-margin ('Job Atlas margin 15% · $20k gross') and admin-team-cost under Budget ('Team cost $134k').
critical_code_review_comments: pricing.py is well-scoped, single source of truth, and imports lazily inside handlers to avoid circular imports — good pattern. No changes needed.

routes/projects.py — _maybe_fire_variance_alert catches ALL exceptions with a bare `except Exception: pass` when mailing. If the alert doc write succeeded but Resend blows up, we silently drop the trace. Consider `logger.exception('variance email failed')` so on-call has a breadcrumb.

server.py POST /projects/lead — payload still exposes optional `estimated_monthly_cost` / `estimated_total_cost` on ProjectLeadIn even though the handler now ignores them (quote is recomputed server-side). Recommend removing from the pydantic model so the API contract is honest.

routes/projects.py convert_lead_to_project — good that contact_email → employer_id auto-links, but this is case-sensitive only because contact_email is lowered on ingest. If a legacy lead was inserted with mixed-case email before that normalisation, the link will silently miss. Consider a case-insensitive regex lookup as a belt-and-braces safeguard.

server.py is 2743 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting pricing/quote handlers, template routes, and lead intake into their own routers to keep parity with the routes/ package pattern.
GET /alerts/mine — no pagination; returns up to 200 alerts. Fine now, but a noisy project could easily flood an employer inbox. Add ?limit/?offset when volume grows.
seed_data_creation: Created one fresh lead via public POST /projects/lead (contact_email=emp-series-b-fintechs@test.io, template=fintech-kyc-aml, assigned_team=[{PM, Rosie, $140}], 6mo) → converted to a project via admin scope. Auto-linked employer_id, generated 4 milestones @ $38,640. Then logged 2 variance rows (+25% breach + 0% flat) as the linked employer; 1 alert doc created. Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration23_pricing_variance_alerts.py — run with `pytest ... -n 0` because the addopts of pytest.ini fixes -n 2 --dist loadscope but this file is sequential (session-scoped fixtures chain lead→convert→variance→alerts, must run in one worker). Auth on this backend is cookie-based (POST /api/auth/login sets an httpOnly cookie; response body has NO `token` field) — use a requests.Session (already done in this file). Resend key remains unset so alert.email_sent stays False but the alert doc persists (which is the contract). If you re-run frontend, note that the template-detail modal shows 'Loading blueprint…' until GET /projects/templates/{id} resolves — wait_for_selector on `[data-testid=live-monthly-cost]` (not the modal itself) before asserting.
